title: GasBack English narration - production draft
status: DRAFT: live-run claims require final evidence approval before publication

segments.evidenceGate: Show testnet labels. General product description; no live success claim.
segments.text: A failed transaction should not require a support ticket. GasBack lets a protocol sponsor a fixed rebate, paid only after the failure is independently verified.

segments.evidenceGate: PENDING FINAL EVIDENCE CHECK: show actual ticket issuance before the matching source action; verify sender, destination, nonce, input hash, block window, beneficiary and amount.
segments.text: The sponsor authorizes this exact transaction intent before the user acts. The ticket fixes who gets paid, the amount, and the claim window. This is a fixed sponsor subsidy, not a full gas refund.

segments.evidenceGate: PENDING FINAL EVIDENCE CHECK: actual prospective project Sepolia receipt has status zero and matches the prior ticket. Do not substitute the historical probe.
segments.text: Here is our actual Sepolia transaction. The demo deliberately reverts, so this is a reproducible failed receipt. The proof establishes the failure, not who was at fault.

segments.evidenceGate: PENDING FINAL EVIDENCE CHECK: native verification of this prospective run succeeds. Show the real measured preparation interval and label recorded playback.
segments.text: After attestation, the relayer obtains a proof. Creditcoin verifies it through the native Attestcoin precompile. The vault then reads those same verified bytes and checks every sponsor policy condition. Attestation preparation time is shown separately.

segments.evidenceGate: PENDING FINAL EVIDENCE CHECK: actual Creditcoin mined receipt status one; RebatePaid identity and amount match; ticket consumed. This paragraph must not be published before the payout is observed.
segments.text: The matching failed transaction receives the fixed sponsor rebate in test C T C. This is the mined claim receipt. A relayer may submit the proof, but cannot change the beneficiary or the amount.

segments.evidenceGate: PENDING FINAL EVIDENCE CHECK: read-only duplicate check rejects this paid claim. Show altered-payload and successful-receipt evidence explicitly as LOCAL POLICY TESTS unless separate real evidence is available.
segments.text: Repeating this claim is rejected by a read-only call. Local policy tests also reject an altered payload and a successful source receipt. These checks do not represent extra mined transactions.

segments.evidenceGate: PENDING FINAL EVIDENCE CHECK: public source, proof, policy and payment evidence links resolve and contain the actual prospective run.
segments.text: GasBack turns a remote failed receipt into a bounded, inspectable sponsorship decision. The source, proof, policy and payment evidence are available for review. All assets shown are test assets.
